MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 25
   C. 19.7
   D. 19

2. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

3. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

4. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 169
   C. 170
   D. 13

5. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 12
   C. 33
   D. 32

6. Solve for x: x + 4 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 6
   D. 7

7. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 73
   C. 1
   D. 72

8. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 26
   C. 25
   D. 5

9. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.7
   C. 15.6
   D. 21

10. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 7
   C. 49
   D. 50

11. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 121
   C. 122
   D. 22

12. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 17
   C. 13
   D. 7

13. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27.7
   C. 27
   D. 33

14. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

15. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 10
   C. 11
   D. 100

16. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 120
   B. 46
   C. 23
   D. 30

17. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 37

18. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 9
   C. 82
   D. 81

19. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 48

20. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. 2/2
   D. Cannot tell

21. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.6
   C. 31.7
   D. 37

22. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 6x

23. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 38
   B. 88
   C. 19
   D. 22

24. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 25

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
